the human capital domain of the entrepreneurship ecosystem consists of four generic archetypes: the local entrepreneur, who has a short and narrow education, the global entrepreneur who has a long and narrow education, and the two incremental entrepreneurs, the one who has short and broad education, and the other who has long and broad education.

The entrepreneur's mindset is an important component of the ecosystem that can be captured in four archetypes, the global entrepreneur and the radical entrepreneur being the ones most likely to succeed.
